import numpy as np
from numpy.linalg import lstsq
# fit residual of prior model structure: c0 sqrt t + c1 A^3 exp(-k t)  ; estimate residual vs t at fixed low A
def f(t,A,p): return p[0]*np.sqrt(t)+p[1]*A**3*np.exp(-p[2]*t)
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
r=least_squares(lambda p: f(t,A,p)-dA_dt, [3.8,0.17,0.09])
print(r.x, np.mean((f(t,A,r.x)-dA_dt)**2)/np.var(dA_dt))
res=dA_dt-f(t,A,r.x)
for lo,hi in [(0.2,0.6),(0.6,1.5),(1.5,3),(3,4.1)]:
    m=(A>=lo)&(A<hi); print(lo,hi,np.round(np.mean(res[m]),3), np.round(np.std(res[m]),3))
for lo,hi in [(0.5,2),(2,4),(4,7),(7,10.1)]:
    m=(t>=lo)&(t<hi); print('t',lo,hi,np.round(np.mean(res[m]),3), np.round(np.std(res[m]),3))
